purpose: Implement the accepted end-to-end S0–S7 plan through pathfinding; infrastructure supports the computation.
execution_rules: Statuses are plans, not execution testimony.
One integration owner for shared executor/contracts/Git; disjoint experimental ownership for algorithm lanes.
No broader authoring task blocks demonstrated S1 integration landing.
Ordinary bounded loops stay in named composite functions; shared machinery records named child invocations.
Outputs can be ordinary objects; domain states need faithful presentation, not a universal schema.
Exact source checkpoint and policy selection precede any historical algorithm port.
Useful checkpoints carry invocation, material, gaps and pushed Git handoff.
PLAN.md is the accepted end-to-end scope; the older infrastructure-only synthesis is historical. Later stages are planned deliverables, not optional kit pilots.
decisions_for_sam: Review actual material and meaningful semantic changes as stages progress.
Choose the exact accepted checkpoint and target when landing.
Resolve source-policy tradeoffs only when code/evidence cannot determine a behavior-preserving choice.
deferred_infrastructure: Graph-level foreach/branch/convergence syntax unless a concrete pilot requires it.
Automatic cache/invalidation engine, scan fusion, dependency scheduler and optimizing compiler.
YAML alias shorthand beyond deterministic existing addresses/occurrences.
Product compile-away work: verify approved calculations remain browser-compatible when product integration is scheduled; no second detector implementation.

tasks.title: Run/render Dash proof, then redo the checklist with Sam
tasks.work: First receiving-agent task: execute separate S0/S1 graphs on full DashsTrack, repair bounded run blockers, show actual material, then revise REFINE with Sam. No success claim from authored code.
acceptance: Show canonical crop, badge readings and distinct owned/muted/remaining renders.
Compare canonical bytes, crop proposal, decode-once/direct identity, all 15 S1 intermediate outputs and four public outputs.
Return exact run command, source identity, failures and a pushed review checkpoint.
tasks.falsifier: Comparison expectations or algorithm knobs are changed to manufacture parity; source is pre-cropped; masks/receipt are not shown.

tasks.title: Consolidate async/direct-result execution into shared PQL
tasks.work: Use the prototype as a migration fixture. Keep old string-address YAML valid; resolve explicit direct-result bindings, await each call, retain prefix/failure, and publish only explicit outputs. Avoid leaving two authoritative executors. Reconcile with PCR-001 findings before acceptance.
acceptance: One shared execution path runs existing S1 YAML and separate generated S0/S1 YAML.
One async producer can feed two consumers with the same object, across Ticks in one invocation.
Repeated invocations isolate direct values; a thrown call preserves completed records and actual failing input.
tasks.falsifier: Generated execution still requires its own production runner, redecodes an image, or loses the successful prefix.

tasks.title: Record actual nested named calls and source versions
tasks.work: Provide shared named-child invocation inside ordinary composite-function loops. Record parent ID, callsite/item key, occurrence order, actual fn, bindings/input references, output/publication and status. Use lightweight source/version identities and immutable input discipline; do not deep-copy all rasters. State body-hash transitive-dependency limits.
acceptance: Basket.findPx emits one real child occurrence per basket; zero members means zero child calls.
Three keyed trace children show two endpoints and one unknown partial result; execution failure retains earlier siblings.
Address replacement cannot relabel an earlier source record; shared fork mutation is detected or explicitly prevented at the authored boundary.
tasks.falsifier: Registration is counted as invocation, child records are manually maintained in every algorithm, or an unknown result is treated as a thrown error.

tasks.title: Select a Stage composition and return its successful board
tasks.work: Add one shared Stage adapter: selected composition, stage-local preparation and public-output boundary supplied once. Resolve outputs by address and return selected variant PxC to the normal pipeline. Preserve explicit failures and complete composition execution.
acceptance: Normal entry explicitly selects YAML S1 and returns that variant board.
Missing public output or failed selection fails visibly; no silent clean fallback.
Appending a Tick does not change public output lookup.
tasks.falsifier: Adapter passes the original board, substitutes clean after failure, or interprets the final Calculation position as the contract.

tasks.title: Bridge actual S1 material into the existing S2 consumer
tasks.work: Centralize shape conversion to px.image.cropped and px.components using actual selected-run Parts. Determine whether labels/statistics can be projected faithfully; any new semantic calculation is recorded. Existing S2 consumes shared components, not badge remaining pixels. Do not silently introduce exclusion behavior.
acceptance: S2 consumes components traceable to the chosen S1 run, without rerunning old S1 detection.
Show source-to-consumer dimensions, labels, component pixels and required statistics; identify any intentional difference.
Run the normal S0→selected S1→existing S2 entry and render resulting baskets.
tasks.falsifier: A compatibility helper reruns a detector or changes masks/thresholds without an explicit calculation and behavior review.

tasks.title: Share material traversal and default inspection
tasks.work: Use one traversal for actual pixel-set/component/mask material, constituent objects, scalar measurements, relations and rejected/empty/unknown outcomes. Address-based inspection uses the same records as execution. Missing presentation support is explicit. Per-item diagnostic fields remain domain output, not manually authored execution tracing.
acceptance: S1 numbers, explained pixels, extra muted pixels, full bbox query and remaining pixels keep distinct meanings.
CLI and browser inspect the same material; an appended Tick does not break object selection.
A partial recovery trace and a failed-run prefix stay visible. Run/View arguments stay separated.
tasks.falsifier: Rendering reruns CV, mutates source Parts, hides rejected/unknown rows, or treats basket bbox as owned ink.

tasks.title: Review and land the demonstrated S1 integration checkpoint
owns: accepted checkpoint only; target branch requires Sam selection
tasks.work: Materialize integrated behavior, push-review the exact checkpoint, get Sam visual acceptance and target branch, then land only that accepted revision. Authoring conveniences are not prerequisites.
acceptance: Selected S1 runs, existing S2 uses it, actual material is inspectable.
Exact accepted SHA and target recorded; later implementation work preserved.
tasks.falsifier: S1 landing waits on shorthand/optimizer work or is declared complete from isolated proof parity.

tasks.title: Define Calculations once and collect them stage-locally
tasks.work: Lightweight definition infers function types and owns input names/defaults; collection derives registration. Composition owns bindings/output addresses, Stage owns required public outputs. Remove duplicated bookkeeping while keeping these distinct decisions. No comprehensive experimental runtime schemas.
acceptance: Fresh Luna adds a meaningful Calculation and composition call without editing executor or UI files.
Resolved defaults and named inputs shown by check/explain come from the same definition used in invocation.
tasks.falsifier: Author maintains separate registration, inspector, consumes/produces and documentation lists for one call.

tasks.title: Target experiments by occurrence and isolate their results
tasks.work: Make explicit occurrence ID the unambiguous override target. Reused functions keep independent calls. Selected experiment executes its full composition. Preserve separate variant boards/results and immutable inputs; retain resolved args/source/code identity and hash limitations.
acceptance: Override one of S1 findRelated occurrences and show the others unchanged.
Unknown/ambiguous target is rejected before execution.
Compare two variants from the same source without mutation leakage or hidden activation flags.
tasks.falsifier: Function-address override unintentionally changes every call or previous results change after another variant runs.

tasks.title: Expose check/explain from the resolved composition and run
owns: LAB CLI entry for that surface
tasks.work: Before execution resolve functions, inputs/defaults, dependencies and public outputs. Afterwards enumerate actual PQL/Calculation calls, exact source/result references, failures and consumer boundary. Read definitions/records rather than making a second metadata registry. Keep unfamiliar values inspectable.
acceptance: Missing input/invalid override/wrong consumer shape fails visibly; unfamiliar experimental object does not fail merely for lacking a renderer.
Runtime inventory shows actual calls in deterministic sequence, including zero child calls and prefix failure.
A source or Run Arg change is explicit in result identity; View Arg changes do not imply rerun.
tasks.falsifier: Grep/declaration inventory is presented as execution, or compiler and inspector use independently maintained call metadata.

tasks.title: Implement S3 visible-tee composition and handoff
owns: one selected S3/exp subtree including badge compatibility; no clean promotion
tasks.work: Select the compatible visible-tee checkpoint from visible-tees.md. Express its existing named calculations and Parts through the kit; preserve component, family, pixel, geometry and rejected-material semantics. Do not choose the newest branch merely by date. S3 currently requires old px.badges with badge.has.mute.px, not new px.badges.objects alone. Project the full badge exclusion footprint via the ownership query, not merely additional px.badges.muted. Historical G3 includes fill, original-image Y alignment, and component/recovered passthrough; clean S3 does not. Preserve this distinction and make any legacy TeeEvidence projection explicit.
acceptance: One Terra/Luna author can wire, run, inspect and hand off the selected S3 with no executor/UI edits.
Show exact consumed S1/S2 representations and any unported behavior against the chosen source.
S3 badge exclusion uses the full declared footprint; prove a center in explained badge pixels is excluded as well as one in additional muted pixels.
tasks.falsifier: Conversion silently substitutes a weaker detector or claims historical Gate and new Stage are equivalent. Using only additional muted pixels for S3 center exclusion also fails.

tasks.title: Implement S4 association and constrained recovery
owns: one recovery/association experimental subtree with separate named calculations
tasks.work: Choose one compatible source set. Keep global component search, constrained-fit alternatives/rejections and dedupe in ordinary composite functions. Keep association a separate decision. Use shared keyed child calls for per-lock basket traces. Domain partial/unknown is not execution failure.
acceptance: Whole visible remnant retained after pixel-level ownership exclusion; all considered candidates have outcomes.
Ambiguous recovery has named winner/losers; association exposes one-to-one alternatives and partial basket trace.
Same components cannot win because of loop order; no bbox-as-basket-ownership.
tasks.falsifier: A domain loop demands new graph syntax, or copying algorithm code also copies generic tracing plumbing.

tasks.title: Implement S5 straight/bent/unknown decisions
owns: one owner-selected experimental stage subtree for geometry inventory
tasks.work: Use existing measureStraightGeometry definitions over identified endpoint candidates. Publish composite proposals/rejected/unknown/measurements; use explicit extraction only when independently addressable children are needed. Preserve blind ABSTAIN semantics; select source policy with Sam before changing decisions. Split raw geometry from the explicit straight/bent/unknown decision Calculation. Preserve blind ABSTAIN in the historical measurement reference; do not silently equate it with the new classification. Resolve decision policy with observed material and Sam if meaning remains ambiguous.
acceptance: Every eligible input has an outcome; missing/degenerate geometry remains unknown.
One composite value direct-feeds children and publishes through declared outputs; downstream never depends on RunRecord position.
Render straight, bent and insufficient-evidence cases with the actual measurements and policy used.
tasks.falsifier: A score is promoted into identity/ownership or a consumer must inspect interpreter-private output fields.

tasks.title: Resolve competing endpoint assignments from retained candidates
owns: one experimental assignment module and composition; exact stage mapping deferred
tasks.work: Older P5/P6 are reusable pattern references. Preserve the chosen candidate-edge meaning and document any semantic change. Keep matrix construction/solver in named composite functions and expose allowed edges, locks, rejected solver choices and unresolved rows. Strong local S6 decisions constrain arbitration when available. Keep conflict/unresolved records and allow bounded re-evaluation from new path evidence.
acceptance: No solver-created candidate edge or duplicated accepted ownership.
Forbidden/sentinel result becomes unresolved with reason; matrix source and selected pairs are inspectable.
tasks.falsifier: Assignment completeness is treated as proof of physical identity or old thresholds are imported without source-policy review.

tasks.title: Optional bounded two-cycle path/assignment refinement
owns: one experimental path adjudicator; no generic cache/scheduler changes
tasks.work: If this historical approach is selected, pass the same caller-built RibbonMassSegmentation to both consumers. Keep finite eligible-pair enumeration, four-distance evidence gate and strongest-first non-overlap application in one named composite. Supplied experiment policy owns improvement thresholds.
acceptance: Every applied swap has existing alternate edges, required measurements and a stated improvement rule.
Unknown distance is skipped with reason; locks and source segmentation are preserved; one hole appears in at most one applied pair.
tasks.falsifier: This bounded case is used to justify unbounded graph control flow or opaque automatic caching.

tasks.title: Complete S2 readable composition and basket endpoint handoff
owns: selected S2/exp composition and calculation modules
tasks.work: Translate existing family/shell/pixel sequence through the kit, publish exact basket pixels and endpoint geometry with incomplete/rejected material. Keep detector semantics and actual child calls.
acceptance: Render family, shell, exact pixels and tips; show consumers receive those outputs.
tasks.falsifier: Basket bbox becomes ownership or endpoint geometry is silently guessed by the viewer.

tasks.title: Resolve supported straight holes locally
tasks.work: Evaluate retained basket candidates against established tee–badge direction and straightness measurements. Keep supported local relationships and unresolved conflicts. Allow path evidence to re-evaluate affected candidates without waiting for all holes.
acceptance: Show supported straight-hole endpoint choices, alternatives and unresolved cases.
Trace every decision to geometry/path material and explicit decision arguments.
tasks.falsifier: All holes are force-assigned or local progress waits for global perfection.

tasks.title: Build and expose the path-support field
owns: selected path-support experimental module and composition
tasks.work: Wrap/reuse computeRibbonSupport over canonical pixels; expose support, preferred direction, scale/frame and actual args. Preserve raw field so newer Dash support variants can be compared at this boundary. Can proceed using existing canonical fixture independently of later Stage ports.
acceptance: Render support/direction over the same canonical image.
Two consumers reuse the same published field with source and arguments recorded.
tasks.falsifier: Support is recomputed secretly by the viewer or has ambiguous scale/origin.

tasks.title: Expose occlusion-derived support and traversal cost
tasks.work: Make patchBadgeOcclusion behavior an explicit derived field with changed-cell testimony; retain original support. BuildSupportCost maps selected support to cost. Keep badge assumptions separate from visible evidence and basket ink ownership.
acceptance: Show raw support, derived occlusion cells and cost with arguments.
Original field remains unchanged; inferred continuation is labeled.
tasks.falsifier: A hidden mutation changes source support or unsupported continuation is presented as observed pixels.

tasks.title: Search once per anchor and reconstruct candidate legs
owns: selected routing composition and wrappers around routing.ts
tasks.work: Reuse routeBadgeLegs/flood/pathFor semantics: one search per badge, shared for candidate tees and baskets. Expose cost/search reuse so splitting functions does not duplicate cost construction. Keep path/frame mapping, endpoint IDs, reachability, costs and child-call testimony. Use available local anchors or explicit fixtures; do not wait for globally complete endpoints.
acceptance: Show one actual search per badge and multiple reconstructed candidate legs.
Render reachable/unreachable/partial outcomes and confirm canonical coordinate mapping.
Bound work explicitly and retain completed material if interrupted or failed.
tasks.falsifier: A flood is repeated per tee–basket pair or reachability is mistaken for accepted identity.

tasks.title: Assemble and assess complete candidate hole paths
owns: selected candidate-path composition and scoring modules
tasks.work: Compose candidate tee–badge–basket legs using makeRawPairs/makeRawPairEvidence and explicit endpoint geometry/path measurements. Preserve path alternatives, score components and rejection/unknown reasons. Local S6 output can narrow candidates when available but is not a universal prerequisite.
acceptance: Render competing complete/partial path hypotheses with component scores and endpoints.
A reachable but poorly supported or conflicting route remains a candidate/rejected result rather than becoming a hole fact.
tasks.falsifier: Pair construction reruns routing or discards losing paths/reasons.

tasks.title: Deliver numbered hole paths and bounded refinement
owns: selected hole-path output/refinement composition and materialization
tasks.work: Publish numbered holes with tee geometry, basket endpoint, selected path, provenance and observed/inferred/unknown sections. Preserve supported locks; feed new route evidence back only to affected unresolved candidates with a recorded stop condition. Refine geometric path quality without fabricating evidence; two-cycle swaps remain optional PCR-015.
acceptance: Render numbered hole paths, unresolved sections and alternatives on Dash.
Every accepted connection traces to endpoint and route material; every input hole has an explicit outcome.
Return pushed checkpoint, invocation, images, gaps and stage wiring checklist suitable for fresh-context Refine.
tasks.falsifier: Retry-until-18, silent reassignment of accepted anchors, or fabricated line segments presented as observed path.

plan.scope: S0 intake through S7 pathfinding and hole paths
plan.revision_rule: Record refinements explicitly; do not silently drop later stages back to pilots.

parallel_path_work: PCR-018 starts once canonical Dash material is available; PCR-020 uses available anchors or explicit fixtures. Global endpoint completeness is not a prerequisite.
